# baffinbay_ca_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay CA Certificate by UUID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_ca_certificate" "origin" {
  name = "Example Root CA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The CA certificate UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.
- `name` (String) The exact, case-sensitive CA certificate name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be configured.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded CA certificate chain returned by the API.
- `type` (String)
